claude.result:
Complete. **game.html** is ready to play.

The game implements all 13 priority systems:
1. **Core loop** with seeded PRNG (mulberry32, seed 1337 default) and deterministic turn order
2. **8×8 map** with 5 terrain types, buildings with terrain/adjacency requirements
3. **Production chains**: ore→metal (forge), ash→soil→food (greenhouse), water (condenser)
4. **Population**: 4 colonists per job, skills (1–5), fatigue/morale mechanics
5. **Needs**: food & water consumption; morale collapse triggers departures
6. **Research tree**: 8 nodes with prerequisites, unlock buildings & bonuses
7. **Events**: 10 weighted events, 4+ with 2–3 choice outcomes that alter state
8. **Trade**: caravan every 5–10 turns with dynamic prices and inventory limits
9. **Ashstorms**: every 8 turns (scaling severity), damages buildings, spikes water consumption
10. **Save/Load**: JSON copy-paste (no browser storage), validation on load
11. **Win/Lose**: Victory at turn 60 with 12+ population; defeat at 0 population; scored summary
12. **UI**: 6 tabs (Map, People, Research, Trade, Log, Dev); tooltips everywhere; responsive at any width; Space to end turn, 1–5 for tabs
13. **Tests & Benchmark**: 15 assertions (resources, caps, prereqs, save/load round-trip) + 200-turn deterministic benchmark with state hash

All systems interact: research unlocks buildings, production fuels morale, morale affects labor, labor drives production. No dead UI; every button works. Winnable and losable by design.
